user.title: Connect to Ghostfolio
user.description: Enter the URL of your Ghostfolio instance and the security/access token shown when your user was created.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Ghostfolio
reauth_confirm.description: The access token for {url} is no longer accepted. Enter a new security token from My Ghostfolio → Account → Security token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Ghostfolio
reconfigure.description: Change the connection to the Ghostfolio instance currently at {url}, for example after moving it to a new address or to HTTPS. Leave the access token empty to keep the current one.

abort.already_configured: This Ghostfolio instance is already configured.
